prompt_title: Write a story inspired by the ultimate clichéd twist: it was all just a dream.
Center your story around a character’s addiction or obsession.
Write a story that keeps a key detail hidden from the reader until the very end.
Center your story around a character who successfully — or unsuccessfully — escapes their fate.
Write a story with a huge surprise, either in the middle or the end.
Write a story in which the first and last sentence are the same.
Create a title with Reedsy’s Title Generator, then write a story inspired by it.
Write a story in the form of a letter, or several letters sent back and forth.
Center your story around someone who’s at a loss for words, or unable to speak.
Write a story with the line "I didn’t mean that” or “I’ve said too much.”
Write a story that includes the line “Do I know you?” or “Have we met before?”
Start or end your story with a character making food or a drink for themself or someone else.
Center your story around a character who yearns for someone or something they’ve lost — or never had.
Write a story with a person’s name in the title.
Center your story around two characters who like each other but don’t get a happily ever after.
Write a story where a character's true identity or self is revealed.
Include the word “hero,” “mask,” or “truth" in your story’s title.
Write a story from the POV of someone who’s hiding a secret.
Center your story around someone’s public image and private self colliding.
Write a story that includes the line "Can you keep a secret?" or “My lips are sealed."
